episodes.186657: Slow moving thunderstorms created localized flooding in Bladen County, NC.
episodes.186716: An isolated waterspout was observed north of Key West in association with a narrow convective cloud line along the Gulf of Mexico side of the lower Florida Keys.
episodes.186770: A band of rain moved southeast through southeast Minnesota during the morning and afternoon hours of October 6th resulting in wet road conditions. In Houston Township, a tractor and pickup truck were travelling east on Minnesota Highway 16 during the afternoon when they collided at the Redding Road intersection. The pickup truck passenger was transported to the hospital with injuries.
episodes.186789: Deep troughing pivoted over the Great Lakes 10/6 into 10/7 as an associated cyclone trekked across Ontario. An attendant cold front swung across northern Michigan during the late afternoon/early evening, supporting a line of showers that worked across Lake Michigan. As these showers began to move overland, the combination of cool air temperatures in the 40s and relatively warm Great Lakes water temperatures supported the development of a waterspout over Little Traverse Bay.

events.narrative: Water was flowing across Johnsontown Road  but road was still passable.

Volunteer observers reported 0.1 of rainfall from bands of rain that moved through southeast Minnesota on October 6th. During the afternoon of October 6th, a tractor and pickup truck collided along Minnesota Highway 16 and Redding Road in Houston Township resulting in an injured passenger.
